summary: Quote, then Depth, on one equity: the instrument moves from QUOTE to SNAP_QUOTE and back as subscriptions come and go, and the last release unsubscribes it.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.
Angel sends the book totals as doubles; the web passes the double on (1000.0), the desktop sends the whole quantity (1000), as every other broker's totals and the docs' integer quantities are.
